visualReview.scope: Representative actual Game View PNGs; all 32 PNG dimensions and freshness are independently checked by the capture runner.
observations: The sixth city row and its button are fully inside the settled viewport at all four requested resolutions.
Nora's long story and the acceptance button are readable in portrait orientation; smaller landscape layouts use the existing scroll area.
Bram's third chapter presents two readable choices. His actor and the visible memory props remain after the real scene roundtrip.
The city sign, forest palette and authored buildings render with their textures; no missing-shader presentation was observed.
visualReview.resolvedCaptureIssue: The first portrait travel capture used a scroll position before resolution reflow. The final sequence scrolls and checks the sixth row after Screen dimensions settle, before capturing.
limits: Individual memory props are small at district overview zoom. Branch identity is established by accompanying runtime checks, not by the overview PNG alone.
Assistant inspection is not user art approval or physical-device touch and audio evidence.

foundationEvidence: Domain test advances the first twelve local main quests using real economy and assigned workers, without previous-city income, premium spending or recovery. Later story and visual coverage uses diagnostic fixtures.
